sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because a nil channel is never ready.
sketches.resonance: The program waits for an answer from a passage that was never opened.

sketches.mechanism: A Lua table cannot store nil; assigning nil to a key deletes that entry.
sketches.resonance: When a thing becomes nothing, even the address where it was kept disappears.

sketches.mechanism: Nothing is the bottom type in Kotlin, so an expression that never returns can type-check wherever any value is required.
sketches.resonance: Absence can meet every expectation only because it never arrives.
sketches.draft:
fun nobody(): Nothing = throw Exception()
val count: Int = nobody()
val name: String = nobody()
